newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates drop at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates drop at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates dropped at mid-session on Tuesday on easing liquidity in the banking system, and dealers said they expected the mild downtrend to continue.

The overnight interbank rate was at 6.070 percent against Monday's 6.323 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.25-6.30 against 6.35-6.40.
Dealers said the rates would not fall too far due to the planned injection of T$8 billion negotiable certificates of deposit by the central bank later this afternoon.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1275-1480 percent against 6.1000.
